_help: Grandma June's postcards, in story order. front: picture (assets/sprites/...). text: the handwritten back. Which level hides which postcard is set in campaign.json. final_letter is shown once all postcards are found.

postcards.text:
Sweetheart,
Your grandfather Teo and I once missed the last tram up the hill, so we walked all night and ended up on a garden wall above the river. The sun came up gold over the rooftops. Teo said: "Every sunrise is the world saying: let's try again." I have been saying it ever since.
Love, Grandma June

Dear one,
I got up at 4 to find a famous temple for sunrise and got completely lost. Instead I found a tiny tea shop, and Mrs. Aoki taught me that tea must be made slowly, like a good morning. (I found the temple later. It was next door.)
Slowly, slowly,
Grandma June

Hello from the island!
Everyone comes here for the sunsets. I came for the sunrise, and had the whole cliff to myself: just me, a donkey called Stavros and a very sleepy baker. The baker gave me warm bread. Stavros tried to eat my hat. Best morning of the year.
June

My darling,
The call to prayer woke me before dawn, so I climbed onto the roof of the riad and watched the sky turn the colour of saffron. Afterwards I bargained for the spices in our kitchen rack. I definitely paid too much. Worth every coin.
Hugs, Grandma

Sweetheart,
In summer here the sun barely sets, so it barely rises either! I waited up all night for a sunrise that never really left. Teo would have laughed at me. I laughed too, and cried a little, and then laughed again. That's how it goes, and that's alright.
Your Grandma June

final_letter.title: A letter from Grandma
final_letter.text:
My dear,
If you are reading this, you found every one of my postcards. I hid them because I wanted you to find what I found: every morning is a present you get to open again.
The penthouse is yours to fill with light while I'm away. Leave the balcony door open tomorrow. I'll be home soon, with a suitcase full of new stories.
All my love, always,
Grandma June

P.S. Mango has breakfast at 7:00. Sharp. He will remind you.
